Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about AI Stylist

AI Stylist online: personal virtual fashion assistant from a photo

MyBestLook is your digital image maker. The tool analyzes your face, body shape, and color type and recommends looks that suit you — without expensive consultations. Use AI to find a better version of yourself and end the eternal "nothing to wear" problem. The smart algorithm helps in every situation: from an outfit check to the perfect look for everyday, work, or evening.

Virtual try-on from a photo: test clothes easily

The app shows how a jacket, dress, or jeans will look on you before you buy. Upload a photo, and the system places the item realistically on your body. Ideal for testing trends, changing your style, and avoiding bad purchases — right in the browser.

AI image maker: change hairstyle and color risk-free

Our AI doesn't only change outfits — it also helps transform your hair. Try Pixie, Bob, Waves, or platinum blonde on your photo without touching the scissors. The generator delivers photorealistic results and keeps your facial features, so you can experiment safely.

Outfit generator & smart wardrobe

Pull new combinations from your closet. Digitize your pieces and get fresh outfit ideas — hoodie with a skirt, blazer with jeans, office or date. Your everyday assistant: spend less and get more looks from what you already own.

Honest style advice right in the fitting room

Unsure in-store or shopping online? Upload your photo and get proportions, colors, and styling rated in seconds. Get a second opinion before checkout — clear, honest, and without polite lies.

AI makeover: create an online photoshoot

Create magazine-ready images in any setting. Choose beach, mountain cabin, or city rooftop — without a photographer or expensive studio. The digital look generator delivers professional composition and perfect light in minutes.
